title: UI/UX Designer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **UI/UX Designer** with 2–3 years of professional experience to design intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of both **User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) design** and be comfortable working closely with product, development, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Conduct user research and understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points.
* Create **user flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs**.
* Develop and maintain consistent design systems, UI components, and design guidelines.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to implement designs accurately.
* Analyze user feedback and improve existing designs based on usability and business requirements.
* Ensure designs are responsive and optimized for different devices and screen sizes.
* Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and product functionality.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends, design standards, and best practices.
* Ensure consistency in branding, typography, colors, layouts, and overall visual design.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in **UI/UX Design**.
* Strong proficiency in **Figma** is required.
* Good understanding of UX principles, user-centered design, and usability.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs.
* Strong knowledge of responsive web and mobile design.
* Understanding of design systems and component-based design.
* Good knowledge of typography, color theory, spacing, grids, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to work collaboratively with product and development teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience designing SaaS, EdTech, e-commerce, or other web/mobile products.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how designs are implemented by developers.
* Experience with tools such as **Adobe Creative Suite, FigJam, Miro, or similar platforms**.
* Experience conducting usability testing and incorporating user feedback.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in **Design, Fine Arts, Computer Science, or a related field** is preferred.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real-world digital products and user experiences.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with product and technology teams.
* Learning and professional development opportunities.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹32,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Interior Designer
description:
Job Description – Modular Kitchen Designer

**Position:** Modular Kitchen Designer / Interior Designer  
**Department:** Design & Sales  
**Industry:** Modular Furniture / Modular Kitchen / Interior Solutions  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and technically proficient **Modular Kitchen Designer** who can understand customer requirements, prepare functional kitchen layouts, create attractive 2D/3D designs, and develop accurate production-ready drawings.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of modular kitchen planning, ergonomics, materials, hardware, accessories, measurements, and manufacturing requirements. The role involves close coordination with customers, sales executives, site supervisors, production teams, and installation teams from initial concept through final execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet customers and understand their requirements, preferences, budget, available space, and functional needs.
* Conduct or verify accurate **site measurements** before finalizing designs.
* Prepare modular kitchen layouts including **L-shape, U-shape, parallel, straight, island and peninsula kitchens**.
* Develop detailed **2D layouts, elevations and 3D presentations/renders** for customer approval.
* Plan base cabinets, wall cabinets, tall units, lofts, pantry units, corner units and appliance integration.
* Ensure proper placement of hob, chimney, sink, refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, oven and other appliances.
* Apply kitchen ergonomics and appropriate **work-triangle principles** while planning layouts.
* Recommend suitable finishes, colour combinations, laminates, acrylic, PU, glass, shutters, countertops and backsplash options.
* Select appropriate kitchen hardware and accessories including hinges, drawer systems, tandem boxes, baskets, corner solutions and lift-up systems.
* Prepare detailed **production/shop drawings** with accurate dimensions.
* Prepare **cutting details, cabinet/module specifications, hardware schedules and BOM (Bill of Materials)** where required.
* Ensure designs are technically feasible and compatible with the company's manufacturing capabilities.
* Coordinate electrical, plumbing, gas, appliance and civil requirements with the customer/site team.
* Prepare quotations or provide design specifications and quantities to the estimation/sales team.
* Revise designs based on customer feedback and obtain final design approval.
* Coordinate with the **production team** to resolve drawing and manufacturing queries.
* Coordinate with **site supervisors and installation teams** to ensure execution according to approved drawings.
* Visit sites when required for measurements, design verification and installation-related issues.
* Maintain proper records of approved drawings, revisions, specifications and customer selections.
* Ensure projects meet agreed quality standards and delivery timelines.

Technical Skills Required

The candidate should have good working knowledge of:

* **AutoCAD**
* **SketchUp**
* **3ds Max / V-Ray / Enscape** or similar rendering software
* **KD Max / KitchenDraw / Winner / Cabinet Vision** or similar modular kitchen software will be an advantage
* MS Excel and MS Office
* Modular cabinet construction
* Kitchen hardware and accessories
* Materials such as plywood, MDF, HDHMR, particle board, laminates, acrylic, veneer, glass and PU finishes
* Countertop materials including granite, quartz and solid surfaces
* Production and installation drawings
* Basic BOM and material estimation

Design Knowledge

The designer should understand:

* Standard modular kitchen dimensions
* Counter heights and depths
* Overhead cabinet planning
* Tall-unit and pantry planning
* Drawer and basket configurations
* Corner-space utilization
* Appliance clearances
* Kitchen ergonomics
* Electrical and plumbing coordination
* Ventilation and chimney requirements
* Hardware selection
* Storage optimization
* Contemporary kitchen design trends

Qualification

**Preferred:** Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Furniture Design or a related discipline.

Candidates with relevant modular kitchen industry experience and strong technical/design skills may also be considered.

Experience

**Preferred:** 2–5 years of experience in modular kitchens, modular furniture or interior design.

Experience in preparing both **customer presentation drawings and production-ready technical drawings** will be preferred.

Key Competencies

* Creative design ability
* Strong space-planning skills
* Attention to dimensions and technical details
* Good visualization skills
* Customer-handling ability
* Communication and presentation skills
* Problem-solving approach
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Coordination with sales, production and installation teams
* Understanding of project timelines and costing

Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy of site measurements and drawings
* Design approval/conversion rate
* Turnaround time for designs
* Number of design revisions
* Accuracy of BOM and production drawings
* Reduction in production/installation errors
* Customer satisfaction
* Timely design-to-production handover
* Adherence to project budgets and specifications

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a designer who combines **creativity with manufacturing practicality**. The candidate should be capable of taking a modular kitchen project from **customer requirement → site measurement → space planning → 2D/3D design → material selection → technical drawings → production coordination → installation support**.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

title: 2D Furniture Designer & Estimation Executive
description:
1\. Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced **2D Furniture Designer \& Estimation Executive** who has practical experience in the **furniture manufacturing industry** and can convert finalized furniture concepts/designs into accurate **2D drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), costing and customer quotations**.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of furniture construction, materials, hardware, dimensions, manufacturing processes and costing.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. 2D Furniture Drawing \& Design

* Prepare accurate **2D furniture drawings** based on approved designs, concepts and customer requirements.
* Prepare detailed drawings with:
* Length, width and height
* Panel thickness
* Joint details
* Edge details
* Hardware positions
* Door/drawer details
* Sectional views wherever required
* Prepare production\-ready drawings for manufacturing.
* Coordinate with the production team to ensure that drawings are practical and manufacturable.
* Modify drawings based on production requirements or customer revisions.
* Maintain proper drawing numbering and revision control.

B. Bill of Material (BOM)

The candidate **must have a strong understanding of BOM preparation**.

Responsibilities include:

* Prepare detailed **BOM for each furniture item/project**.
* Identify and calculate required:
* Plywood / MDF / HDF
* Veneer / Laminate
* Solid wood
* Edge band
* Glass
* Hardware
* Hinges
* Channels
* Handles
* Screws and fittings
* Adhesives and other consumables
* Calculate material quantities based on approved drawings.
* Ensure that BOM quantities are accurate and practical for manufacturing.
* Coordinate with purchase and production departments regarding material availability and specifications.

C. Costing \& Estimation

* Prepare **item\-wise costing** based on the approved design and BOM.
* Calculate material cost, hardware cost and other relevant manufacturing costs.
* Consider wastage/norms while preparing material requirements.
* Coordinate with production/purchase teams to obtain current material and hardware prices.
* Prepare accurate project/item\-wise cost sheets.
* Identify cost\-impacting design changes before final quotation.

D. Quotation Preparation

The candidate should be capable of preparing the **final customer quotation after design finalization**.

Process expected:

**Customer Requirement → 2D Drawing → Design Finalization → BOM → Costing → Management Approval → Final Quotation**

Responsibilities include:

* Prepare item\-wise quotation after finalization of design and BOM.
* Prepare quotations based on:
* Material specification
* Quantity
* Hardware
* Manufacturing cost
* Installation, if applicable
* Transportation, if applicable
* Applicable margins
* Ensure that quotation specifications match the approved drawing and BOM.
* Make revisions in quotations based on changes in design, material or quantity.
* Maintain records of quotations and revisions.

3\. Coordination Responsibilities

The candidate will coordinate closely with:

* Production Team
* Purchase Department
* Sales Team
* Project/Execution Team
* Management
* Vendors/Suppliers

The candidate must be able to clearly communicate **what is to be manufactured, which material is required and how much material is required**.

4\. Required Technical SkillsMust Have

* Practical experience in **2D furniture drawing**
* Experience in **furniture manufacturing**
* Strong knowledge of furniture construction
* Strong understanding of **Bill of Material (BOM)**
* Ability to read and understand furniture drawings
* Ability to calculate material quantities
* Knowledge of plywood, MDF, HDF, laminates, veneer and solid wood
* Knowledge of furniture hardware and fittings
* Experience in **costing and estimation**
* Experience in **quotation preparation**
* Ability to coordinate with production and purchase teams

Software Knowledge

Candidate should preferably have good working knowledge of:

* **AutoCAD / 2D CAD**
* MS Excel
* MS Word
* ERP/software used for estimation and quotation, if applicable

5\. Preferred Industry Experience

Preference will be given to candidates having experience in:

* Modular Furniture Manufacturing
* Customized Furniture Manufacturing
* Residential Furniture
* Commercial Furniture
* Office Furniture
* Hotel Furniture
* Interior Fit\-Out / Furniture Projects
* Wardrobe, Kitchen and Cabinet Manufacturing

6\. Key Competencies

* Strong attention to detail
* Good mathematical and measurement skills
* Accuracy in BOM and costing
* Understanding of manufacturing feasibility
* Ability to work under deadlines
* Good coordination skills
* Problem\-solving ability
* Good knowledge of furniture materials and hardware
* Ability to identify discrepancies between drawing, BOM and quotation

7\. Important Selection Criteria

**Candidates must have practical experience in the complete process:**

**2D Drawing → BOM → Material Calculation → Costing → Quotation**

Candidates who only have **2D drawing experience but do not understand BOM, costing and quotation preparation** will not be preferred.

8\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy of 2D drawings
* Accuracy of BOM
* Accuracy of material calculations
* Accuracy of costing
* Accuracy of quotations
* Reduction in material wastage
* Timely preparation of drawings and quotations
* Coordination with production and purchase teams
* Number of drawing/BOM revisions due to errors
* Adherence to approved specifications and margins

9\. Qualification

**Diploma / ITI / Graduate / Interior Design / Furniture Design / CAD\-related qualification** preferred.

Relevant practical experience in furniture manufacturing may be considered in place of formal qualification.

10\. Experience Required

**Minimum 2 years of relevant experience** in furniture manufacturing, with hands\-on experience in:

**2D Furniture Drawing \+ BOM \+ Costing \+ Quotation Preparation.**

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
